Publish.LongDescription:
## Unique or Signature Buildings
Want more freedom with the Unique buildings and to place multiple without wreaking the economy from mega stacking bonuses?
**Unlock Signature buildings instantly and place multiple copies of Unique buildings.**
**Control Signature bonuses** — normal stacked bonuses, first copy only, or no bonuses.
### Signature bonuses - Normal vanilla, get all the stacking bonuses from multiple Unique buildings and the excess economy this creates. - Only the first building gives a bonus, other copies do not stack the same bonuses; reduces unrealistic economy. - Challenge mode: no bonuses at all, Unique buildings are cosmetic.
### Features
- ✅ **Unlock Signature buildings instantly** — skip population, zoning, and other progression requirements. - ✅ **Place multiple Unique buildings** — including Signature buildings. - ✅ Turn either feature ON or OFF anytime. - Existing buildings stay placed when restrictions are turned back ON. - Built-in Status shows totals and counts of city-wide bonus effects.
### Good to Know
- **Multiple Unique Buildings** is ON by default. - **Signature Unlocks** is OFF by default. Turning on will not flood the screen with 90 Pop-ups. - **Anarchy is supported** can have unlimited unique buildings toggled on in both Anarchy and this mod, it will not conflict. - Remove other Unlimited Unique Buildings mods — to avoid confusion in settings. - Safe to remove anytime. Lightweight: changes apply when needed, then goes idle. - Hover over any Options menu rows for quick help (see 3rd panel on the right).
### Support and Feedback - Easiest way to support is to click the LIKE 👍 button (top right). No donations requested. - For Feedback use the Github or Discord links (right side of page). PRs are welcome.
